plan.line: a flame sensor module: notices the infrared light of a small flame (a lighter or candle) up to about a metre in front of it. Its output is LOW while it sees a flame. Strong sunlight can set it off too. It is a toy detector, not a fire alarm.

code.pinLine: flame sensor {ref} on {gpio}: Pin({g}, Pin.IN). value() is 0 while it sees a flame and 1 otherwise (sensitivity set with its screw). Strong sunlight can also read 0.
